powerGrid.note: Not rated: no archived marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki page exists for Joaquín Torres (CDX index searched for Falcon, Joaquin and Torres pages). His first comics appearance is Captain America: Sam Wilson #1 (2015).

powerOrigins.detail: Karl Malus's experiments spliced him with Redwing, Sam Wilson's vampiric falcon, leaving him a bird-human hybrid whose change cannot revert.

abilities.name: Avian hybrid body
abilities.detail: The experiments gave him feathered winged arms, enlarged eyes and bird-like talons on his hands and feet.

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.detail: Flies by flapping his arms, which have been partly turned into wings.

abilities.name: Regenerative healing
abilities.detail: Vampiric traits from Redwing give him a healing factor that has brought him back from fatal wounds and may even regrow body parts.

abilities.name: Psychic link
abilities.detail: Shares Redwing's psychic bond, so he and Sam Wilson can pass thoughts to each other through the bird.

feats.text: Sensing through Redwing that Sam Wilson had been thrown off a building, he flew to him and caught him in mid-air.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Captain America: Sam Wilson Vol 1 5

feats.text: Came back from death after Cottonmouth bit his head, thanks to his healing factor, then took the Falcon name as Sam's partner.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Captain America: Sam Wilson Vol 1 6

feats.text: Caught Patriot as the Skydream platform exploded, then helped disable its weapons so it could not attack the cities below.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Sam Wilson, Captain America Vol 1 5

feats.text: On his first mission as Falcon he chased three SERPENT mercenaries on motorbikes, shot out a tyre, took them down and recovered the stolen canister.

sources.label: MCU Wiki: Captain America: Brave New World

feats.text: At Camp Echo One he worked out that flashing lights had planted hidden commands set off by a song, then fought off mind-controlled soldiers with Sam.

sources.label: MCU Wiki: Captain America: Brave New World

feats.text: Over Celestial Island he pulled a pilot from a disabled jet and destroyed a missile, but was caught in its blast and fell into the sea.

sources.label: MCU Wiki: Captain America: Brave New World
